daily.today_energy: You're giving grounded visionary energy today, Cap. The universe is asking you to trust your instincts while staying practical. Something you've been building behind the scenes is ready to shift into the light.
daily.love: Connection feels less about grand gestures and more about real presence today. Whether single or coupled, this is your moment to show up authentically. Vulnerability hits different when you're already secure in yourself.
daily.career: Your steady momentum continues, but today invites you to think bigger about what you actually want. Don't just climb—make sure you're climbing toward something that genuinely excites you. Your energy attracts the right opportunities.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance between pushing hard and actually resting. Honor the natural rhythm instead of forcing it. Movement that feels joyful over obligatory will energize you way more right now.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is inviting you to soften your edges, Cap. You've been grinding hard, and the universe is gently suggesting it's time to let people in. Trust the process—vulnerability isn't weakness, it's your superpower.
weekly.love: Whether you're single or coupled up, there's a magnetic quality to your energy right now. Someone's noticing. If you're already boo'd up, this is the week to have those real conversations you've been postponing. Keep it genuine.
weekly.career: Your ideas are hitting different this week—don't sleep on them. There's momentum building around a project or direction you've been exploring. The vibe says to pitch it, share it, or at least test it out. Your instincts are solid.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for more flow and less force. This could mean stretching, dancing, or just moving in ways that feel good instead of obligatory. Notice what makes you feel alive versus drained. That's your north star right now.
